info.name: DX_Control_Plane_API_Tests-SIRPI Copy
info.description:
Comprehensive API test suite for DX Control Plane and ACL APD.

Covers all 130+ endpoints with role-based authentication via Keycloak.

## Setup
1. Import the matching environment file (local-docker or deployed)
2. Run folder '00 – Auth & Token' first to populate tokens
3. Run folders sequentially — later folders depend on IDs created by earlier ones

## Roles
- **cosadmin**: COS Administrator (full platform access)
- **orgadmin**: Organisation Administrator
- **provider**: Data Provider (publishes assets)
- **consumer**: Data Consumer (accesses assets)
- **delegate**: Delegate (acts on behalf of others)

// Usage in folder/request pre-request scripts:
//   eval(pm.collectionVariables.get('getTokenFn'));
//   getToken('cosadmin');
pm.collectionVariables.set('getTokenFn', `
function getToken(role) {
const kc = pm.environment.get('kc_url');
const realm = pm.environment.get('realm');
const clientId = pm.environment.get('client_id');
const username = pm.environment.get(role + '_user');
const password = pm.environment.get(role + '_pass');
const tokenVar = role + '_token';
const existing = pm.collectionVariables.get(tokenVar);
if (existing) {
try {
const payload = JSON.parse(atob(existing.split('.')[1]));
if (payload.exp * 1000 > Date.now() + 30000) return;
} catch(e) {}
pm.sendRequest({
url: kc + '/realms/' + realm + '/protocol/openid-connect/token',
method: 'POST',
header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
body: {
mode: 'urlencoded',
urlencoded: [
{ key: 'grant_type', value: 'password' },
{ key: 'client_id', value: clientId },
{ key: 'username', value: username },
{ key: 'password', value: password }
}, function (err, res) {
if (err) { console.error('Token fetch failed:', err); return; }
pm.collectionVariables.set(tokenVar, res.json().access_token);
// Collection-level test: common response validation
